reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' with no redline and no comment, which is the expected output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is byte-identical to p0049, so nothing was altered.

The cited text supports the preferred position: § 12.3 affirmatively states that nothing restricts Customer from 'hiring any person who responds to general recruitment' and that Customer 'has made no ... no-hire commitment.' No non-solicit, no-poach or no-hire covenant binds Customer in the supplied text, so there is nothing to narrow.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months; carve-out sentence) are correctly treated as non-probative: both regexes look for terms inside an existing restrictive covenant, and no such covenant exists to measure.

The clause runs in our favour, and the playbook expressly directs not to flag clauses benefiting our party; the rationale also correctly avoids double-flagging the separate 24-month non-compete under this rule.

Minor accuracy note (not disqualifying): the rationale's reference to a § 12.4 24-month non-compete on Customer sits awkwardly with § 12.3's statement that Customer made no non-compete commitment; that tension should be resolved when the non-compete rule is reported, not here.
